catalogue_completion_scope.artifact_inventory_digest_definition: SHA256 of canonical JSON sorted by door_id; each row contains door_id, job_sha256, metadata_sha256, image_sha256. Canonical JSON uses sorted keys, compact separators and ASCII escaping.

prepared_recipe_coverage.mapping_count_note: Slot scan counts describe each requested preset before per-geom semantic overrides; hardware, frame, glass and seals may select different presets.

scope.scan_scale_caveat: Provider dimensions are starting points. Brick uses an explicitly recorded DoorBench visual calibration; other provider scales are not certified physical measurements.
scope.source_geometry_assignment_method: Apply the frozen pure preset_for_geom selector to every source visual geom; apply frozen scan preset mappings and the wood_source walnut source-hint rule. Extra environment/decor/detail objects are excluded from geom counts.
scope.statement: These are prepared recipe and source-geometry assignment counts, not personal visual signoff or certification of physical realism. A matching render/image hash only establishes artifact provenance.
scope.timing: Verified after all 1000 catalogue variant_000 render records completed. Separate photo variants may still be running; they are excluded from this completion scope.

source_geometry_material_coverage.note: A door can use several materials and scans, so preset/asset door counts are overlapping, not a partition.

scale_calibration.method: Approximately 5 x 225mm horizontal modules and 15 x 75mm courses; 215 x 65mm standard brick plus 10mm mortar joints
scale_calibration.uncertainty: Visual module calibration, not a measured reconstruction of this particular wall
